title.narrative: Strengthening institutions to enable an environment of freedom of expression and the safety of journalists to conform to international norms and standards.

description.narrative: Ghana has one of the most progressive legislative and policy frameworks on freedom of expression. Over the years interventions have strengthened freedom of expression, the safety of journalists, and access to information but there are considerable gaps in meeting universal norms and standards. The purpose of the intervention will be to support the mandated institutions to further advance these interventions in conformity with international standards. Key activities will include awareness-raising activities using WPFD and IDEI. Additional activities will be the adoption UNESCO module on Freedom of Expression and Safety of Journalists by the Judicial Training Institute of Ghana. The implementation of a monitoring mechanism for the safety of journalists with a focus on the safety of women journalists. Capacities building workshops for duty bearers and right holders within the freedom of expression space. This will engender an enabling environment for freedom of expression and the safety of journalists.
